learning_outcomes.text: Students will know and acquire proficiency in basic techniques related to structural calculation.
The industrial building and its special characteristics, as well as the most common construction solutions, will be described.
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.
Calculate and dimension articulated structures following stiffness and resistance criteria.
Know and apply matrix methods to structural calculation.
Know the characteristics of industrial buildings and their constructive elements.
Know the types of soils and foundation systems according to their properties.
Know the current regulations governing the construction of an industrial building.
Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.

syllabus_topics: General study of industrial structures and installations
Analysis and design of structural elements for industrial plants

assessment_methods.method: Structures Block: Problem and/or theory exam 1
Structures Block: Problem and/or theory exam 2
Structures Block: Problem and/or theory exam 3

assessment_rules: To pass, students must achieve a minimum of 3 out of 10 in each assessment component and an overall grade of 5 out of 10, based on the stated weightings. In the ordinary call, students who did not achieve the minimum 3 points in a component can retake only those specific parts. If they retake a component where they already met the minimum, the new grade replaces the old one. For the extraordinary call, students who failed to meet the minimum in any part or whose overall grade was below 5 must retake the entire course, and no approved parts are carried over. If a student scores below 3 in any partial during the ordinary call, their final ordinary call grade will not exceed 4.
